_note: Final script (design/script_final.html) section 4, village investigation (V20). Each clue is a village hotspot: clicking it shows `discovery` + `narration` once, adds `evidence`, and pins `title` + the evidence text in the Casebook's VILLAGE strip. Hotspot positions live in VillageScene (they follow the background art).

clues.title: FOOTPRINTS
clues.discovery: Footprints lead toward the clock tower and stop suddenly.

clues.title: BLOOD-STAINED KEY
clues.discovery: A small old key with dried blood, near the footprints.

clues.title: UNTOUCHED BELL ROPE
clues.discovery: The bell rope hangs untouched, although the bell rang.

clues.title: EVERY CLOCK AT 2:17
clues.discovery: Pocket watch, wall clock, school clock, church clock, broken watch. All of them show 2:17.

clues.title: STRANGE SYMBOLS
clues.discovery: The same strange symbols, near the clock tower, on the doors and by the old well.

clues.title: DAMAGED RECORDING
clues.discovery: A damaged recording. Through the hiss: "...the lantern..." / "...don't activate it..."
